title: Epistemic Claim Audit & Source-Fidelity Repair
non_scope: rebuilding the research workflow or adding new infrastructure
generating artificial traffic or modifying observatory readiness
acceptance_criteria: Every claim labeled SOURCE_FACT is directly supported by its primary source text.
Toolformer audit separates actual paper findings (self-supervised API filtering on perplexity) from KAD architectural framing.
SWE-bench audit corrects overstatement regarding universal ground-truth validation.
Reflexion and Self-Refine are disentangled with separate source-grounded descriptions.
Metadata status consistency is resolved across source identity, bibliographic metadata completeness, and content provenance.
Deterministic claim-ledger.json documents claim-level verification statuses and supporting locations.
Revised synthesis strictly separates SOURCE_FACT, DERIVED_SYNTHESIS, PROJECT_INFERENCE, and UNKNOWN.
Epistemic gap diagnosis identifies root cause without unnecessary production code churn.
Full regression suite (510+ tests) remains green and doctors report healthy/PASS.
description: Rigorous epistemic claim audit, source-fidelity repair, and claim-level ledger for the five-source research corpus ensuring seed trustworthiness for the governed KAD KnowledgePlane.
